footnote_text: On October 15, 2026, 182 Medtronic plc ("Medtronic") ordinary shares beneficially owned by the Reporting Person were accepted for exchange in Medtronic's exchange offer for shares of common stock of MiniMed Group, Inc. ("MiniMed"). Pursuant to the exchange offer, the Reporting Person received 836 shares of MiniMed common stock based on the final exchange ratio of 4.5939 shares of MiniMed common stock for each Medtronic ordinary share accepted. || Includes 19 shares acquired through dividend reinvestment since the last report filed by the reporting person.
